fields.description: DAMAC Sun City is a Dubailand townhouse community organised around outdoor recreation and wellness facilities. Its four-bedroom middle homes and five-bedroom end homes include private gardens, balconies and terraces. Shared spaces range from coworking and reading areas to outdoor exercise and woodland-style trails.

overview: The four-bedroom layout spans ground and first floors. The five-bedroom end layout adds a second floor containing an additional bedroom, maid accommodation and a terrace. Both plans show two parking spaces. A home's final specification, garden boundary and orientation should be checked against its own contract drawings.
research.locationNote: DAMAC identifies Sun City as Dubailand. The launch map places it near the Emirates Road and Al Qudra Road network. Exact access, proximity to facilities and commute conditions depend on the selected plot and delivery of the surrounding roads.
research.priceNote: The original fact sheet quotes AED 2.25m for four bedrooms and AED 3.01m for five bedrooms. Property Finder currently displays a higher headline launch reference of approximately AED 2.7m. No available home at the historic guide is implied; request a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The original schedule totals 75% before completion and 25% on completion, beginning with 20%. Monthly 1% payments are interrupted by larger 5% milestones. The grouped stages reproduce the fact-sheet timing; the buyer's signed schedule controls exact obligations.
research.handoverNote: The launch sheet anticipates March 2028, also the month on the reviewed Property Finder entry. Treat it as an estimated programme and confirm the selected home's contractual date.
